summary: This CSS defines the styling for a TLDR (Too Long; Didn't Read) summary box component. It creates a visually distinct container with a left border accent, rounded corners, and a subtle shadow, then styles the header with an icon and uppercase title, and the content area with indentation and slightly reduced opacity.

explanations.2: Sets a 5-pixel thick border on the left side of the container, which serves as a visual accent stripe.
explanations.4: Creates a subtle shadow effect around the box (the rgb values with 0.1 at the end mean black at 10% opacity), making it appear slightly elevated from the page.
explanations.8: Enables flexbox layout, which makes it easy to align the icon and title horizontally in the header.
explanations.9: Vertically centers the icon and title within the header area.
explanations.14: Sets the icon to be 1.5 times the normal text size, making it prominently visible.
explanations.19: Converts all text in the title to uppercase letters automatically via CSS.
explanations.20: Adds extra space between letters in the title for a more spaced-out, distinct appearance.
explanations.24: Adds left padding so the content text is indented further than the title, creating a visual hierarchy.
explanations.25: Makes the content text slightly transparent (90% opaque) so it appears less prominent than the title.
